Class ExecutorServiceAdapter

java.lang.Object
java.util.concurrent.AbstractExecutorService
org.springframework.core.task.support.ExecutorServiceAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Executor, ExecutorService
public class ExecutorServiceAdapter extends AbstractExecutorService
Adapter that takes a Spring TaskExecutor and exposes a full java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService for it.

这主要用于适配通过 `java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService` API 进行通信的客户端组件。它也可用作本地 Spring `TaskExecutor` 后端与 Jakarta EE 环境中 JNDI 定位的 `ManagedExecutorService` 之间的通用基础。

注意：此 ExecutorService 适配器不支持 `java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService` API 中的生命周期方法（如 "shutdown()" 等），类似于 Jakarta EE 环境中的服务器级 `ManagedExecutorService`。生命周期始终由后端池管理，此适配器仅作为该目标池的访问代理。

3.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller
